verdict.rationale: Navan is a travel and expense product, so mileage and per-diem claiming is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions mileage logging, map-based distance calculation, or per-diem rates. The closest items are receipt scanning, general expense management and manual-expense API endpoints, which are related features rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an employee, I can log mileage with map-based distance and claim per-diem rates without building the expense by hand
